summary: Overview of the Landscape system: Manage/Sculpt/Paint modes, World Partition proxy integration, memory advantages over static meshes, texture-based render data, geo-mipmap LOD, streaming, collision heightfields with per-layer physical materials, and a full table of Landscape project settings.
